title: SensoBazaar MQTT envelope v1
description: Common envelope for every gateway message. The payload is validated separately against the schema selected by `type` (see payloads/). Field `gatewayId` must equal the MQTT username and the topic segment. Corresponds to ADR-0001 §6.2 and INIT-PLAN phase 0 (bootId required, DEVICE_INVENTORY added).

messageId.description: UUID v7. Preserved on retransmission - the idempotency key.

gatewayId.description: External id of the gateway; equals the MQTT username and topic segment.

sentAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds. Rejected at ingest when more than 5 minutes in the future.

bootId.description: Identifies the gateway process boot (recommend UUID v7). Allows the platform to distinguish a stale Last Will from the current session.

seq.description: Monotonic per-gateway counter, optional, diagnostics only.

signature.description: null in MVP. From S5: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the envelope without this field.
